item.title: Woman identified following deadly crash on I-565 in Huntsville
item.description: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. (WHNT) - A woman who was killed during a multi-vehicle crash on Saturday has been identified. The Huntsville Police Department said that the crash happened in the area of I-565 and Research Park Boulevard just before 6 a.m. The woman who was killed has been identified as Rochelle Ann Hollinquest, 66, of Birmingham.
